fact: At the 4th GMES&Africa national workshop in Nouakchott on 29 July 2025, organised by the University of Nouakchott's mapping and remote sensing centre (CUCT) with OSS and attended by the ministries including Agriculture, operational EO services were presented, including MISBAR agricultural monitoring and the GUETCROP crop and pasture early warning system, with MISLAND and SAQIYA now hosted on national servers.
title: GMES & Africa in Mauritania: Fourth National Workshop on the Use of Earth Observation for Natural Resource Management
publisher: Sahara and Sahel Observatory (OSS), with CUCT, University of Nouakchott
